summary: Learn Python, pandas, and Jupyter workflows for cleaning, exploring, and presenting data. Review the five-day course outline and enrol.
lede: Python-based data analysis focuses on repeatable ways for analysts and reporting specialists to prepare tabular data. You’ll practise importing and profiling files, cleaning and transforming data with pandas, calculating summaries with NumPy, and exploring patterns through labelled Matplotlib and Seaborn charts. Jupyter Notebook exercises build toward a reviewed analysis notebook and concise findings summary for reporting.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course is designed for people who handle datasets, prepare reports, or support analytical work and need to move beyond repeated manual spreadsheet steps. It is suitable for learners beginning Python-based analysis, including those who work with tables but have not yet built coding workflows.
prerequisites: Basic computer and file-management skills are expected. Familiarity with spreadsheet rows, columns, and simple formulas is useful. No prior Python coding experience is required.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
Data science & machine learning in practice
